== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Underworld Contacts & •Uncharted Settlements (Errata)]] (<code>1283_21</code>), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text: the Virtual Block 8.3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-02-Underworld_Contacts_Uncharted_Settlements.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-underworldcontactsandunchartedsettlements-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Underworld Contacts & •Uncharted Settlements]]. The Master List slip prints this text without card art.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List, Light Side, p. 30, official text as of 27 April 2013 ([[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf]]). Published typos and punctuation are kept as printed; icons the source writes out in words are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on [Virtual Block 4] Hidden Base; you must choose alien/[Independent Starship] starship. You may not deploy Ellorrs Madak, Revolution or operatives. Your Destiny is canceled. Opponent generates no Force at Hidden Landing Site. [Virtual Block 1] Yerka Mig may deploy on a Rebel Cell Site, may be placed in Used Pile if it was just lost, and you may retrieve Force with it only once per turn. While Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers on table, attrition against opponent is +1 for each Rebel Cell site you occupy with an alien. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1283_21</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block set mark, copyright line, the errata mark E and the Premium expansion sphere as on the Master List slip) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB8-02-Underworld_Contacts_Uncharted_Settlements-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B12 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
